evals.prompt: I have 4 failing test files in my FastAPI project after a big refactor. tests/test_auth.py has 3 failures, tests/test_billing.py has 2, tests/test_webhook.py has 5, and tests/test_rate_limit.py has 1. All seem like different root causes.
evals.expected_output: Should route to dispatching-parallel-agents pattern: group by failure domain (4 groups), dispatch 4 agents in parallel with full error context, each agent investigates one test file independently. Should NOT route to subagent-driven-development (no feature building here).

evals.prompt: Build me a complete blog system: admin panel for creating posts with auth, a public reader page, REST API for CRUD, and SEO metadata. Here's the spec: posts have title, body, author, tags, published_at. Admin needs login. Public page should be ISR.
evals.expected_output: Should route to subagent-driven-development: extract tasks from spec, dispatch implementer per task with TDD, two-stage review (spec compliance + code quality). Should NOT dispatch all as generic parallel agents (needs the review loop).

evals.prompt: The homepage is slow. I need you to optimize the images, add caching to the API, and write a blog post about our performance improvements.
evals.expected_output: Should route to parallel-work general: 3 independent units (image optimization → visual-engineering, API caching → deep, blog post → writing), all dispatched in same message with appropriate skills loaded. No debugging or TDD review needed.

evals.prompt: Fix the payment webhook bug that's causing duplicate charges, and also add a new analytics dashboard page with charts showing MRR, churn rate, and user growth.
evals.expected_output: Should SPLIT by type: bug fix → dispatching-parallel-agents (investigate webhook), dashboard → parallel-work general or subagent-driven-development (build new feature). Both dispatched in same message. Should NOT bundle into one agent.

evals.prompt: I need to migrate all my API routes from Express to FastAPI. There are about 15 endpoints across 5 files.
evals.expected_output: Should route to parallel-work general: decompose by file (5 units), each agent migrates one file's endpoints. All dispatched in parallel. Should load fastapi-pro skill. Should NOT route to subagent-driven-development (no spec/review loop needed for mechanical migration).
